title: Lord Prepare Me
lyrics_original: Lord prepare me to be a sanctuary,
Pure and holy, tried and true.
With thanksgiving, I'll be a living
Lord prepare me to be a testimony,
Lord prepare me to be a sacrifice,
Pure and holy, tried and true
With thanksgiving, I'll be a living

bible_verses.english: Or don’t you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have from God? You are not your own,
Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your reasonable service.
But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light:

devotional.prayer_english: Lord, prepare my heart to be a sacred dwelling place for Your Holy Spirit. Cleanse my thoughts, refine my desires, and make me a pure and simple testimony of Your goodness. I offer my life to You today as a living sacrifice, full of gratitude for all You have done. May everything I say and do honor You and bring light to those around me. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord, prepare my heart to be a sacred dwelling place for Your Holy Spirit. devotional.reflection_english: God desires our very lives to be sacred spaces where His presence dwells. As we sing these humble words, we invite the Holy Spirit to shape our hearts into living sanctuaries, authentic testimonies, and willing sacrifices of praise. When we yield our daily walk to Him, our lives naturally become places where Christ's love and grace are made visible. May we surrender completely today, letting our lives overflow with quiet joy and genuine thanksgiving.
